reason: I already take magnesium at night at home and I reorder what I use when it runs out. The on-the-go sachet solves a problem I don't have.
objection: I don't need magnesium to go, I take it at home before bed. Why would I switch from what I already reorder to pay $30 for a new brand I haven't heard of?
would_change_my_mind: If I started traveling a lot or going away for weekends and needed something easy to pack, or if my current brand got worse or more expensive.
